rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee
rules.description: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Guerrilla
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Guerrilla, they may move by up to 6" from Guerrilla (instead of only 3").

rules.name: Enhanced Guerrilla Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Guerrilla. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Guerrilla
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Piercing Tag
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to block to get AP(+1) on their weapons.

rules.name: Precise
rules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Reap
rules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 4-6.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Rending
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

rules.name: Rending in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shielded
rules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

rules.name: Shielded Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Strider
rules.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).

rules.name: Strider Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Takedown
rules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

rules.name: Takedown Strike
rules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Aura of Peace
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Bad Omen
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Deep Meditation
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Mind Breaker
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.

spells.name: Piercing Pulse
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Wave of Discord
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with AP(1) and Reap. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.
